notes.title: Diffuculty Balancing and Bug Fixes
notes.content:
- Overall bosses are less punishing
- Reduced Hunter and Warden bosses health
- Hunter hearts now stay until the Warden is killed (giving 3 extra lives for Warden boss)
- Warden Skull remains with player, even upon death
- Various bug fixes

notes.title: Difficulty adjustment and bug fixes
notes.content:
Overall diffuculty when facing the bosses is more appropriate and not so punishing.

- Decrease the Hunter and Warden health
- Hunter hearts now are retained until the Warden is killed
- Various bug fixes
